funding: Create one wallet, manually fund its devnet SOL budget, then Start demo. Budget includes account rent and fees. Faucet may require sign-in and enforce limits.
history: Permanent operation accounts and per-profile activity accounts of 32 records each. Request resolution updates the original entry. SPL Token accounts supply actual balances.
confirmation: Confirmed signature plus expected program state. Signed bytes are saved before broadcast. Retry the same signature until finalized block-height expiry and a history lookup prove it absent; then require explicit retry. Confirmed is not finalized.
